product_overview: Pure Path Lab is a laboratory management system for staff workflows, including patient management, billing, lab result processing, and report verification. It also provides patient-facing OTP access and public verification links for reports and bills.
core_goals: Authenticate staff users and reach the operational dashboard
Create and manage patient records for lab workflows
Create bills, collect payments, and generate invoice PDFs
Enter, save, verify, and preview lab results and reports
Support patient report access through OTP verification
Verify reports and bills through public token links
Manage lab test catalogs, packages, panels, and rates
Support administrative setup, branding, templates, and signatures
Review business summaries and export data

features.name: Staff Login
features.description: Lets Admin, Employee, or Doctor users sign in with their email and password and access the appropriate authenticated area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an authentication error message and remain on the login page

features.name: Public Landing
features.description: Shows the public marketing page and routes visitors to staff login or patient access portals.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the landing page content -> Open the staff login page
Navigate to / -> View the landing page content -> Open the patient report portal

features.name: Patient Report Portal
features.description: Allows patients to request an OTP with their mobile number, verify it, and view or download available reports.
user_flows: Navigate to /patient/report -> Enter mobile number -> Request OTP -> Enter the received OTP -> Verify OTP -> View available reports -> Open or download a report PDF
Navigate to /patient/report -> Enter mobile number -> Request OTP -> Enter an invalid OTP -> Submit verification -> See an OTP error message

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Provides an authenticated home page with summary stats, recent transactions, and quick navigation to key workflows.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View dashboard summary cards -> Review recent transactions -> Open a quick action link to another workflow

features.name: Patient Management
features.description: Lets staff search for patients, create new patient records, and open patient details for further work.
user_flows: Navigate to /cases/patients -> Search for an existing patient -> Open the create patient flow -> Enter patient demographics -> Save the patient record -> Open patient details
Navigate to /cases/patients -> Search for a patient by name or number -> View matching results -> Open a patient record

features.name: Billing
features.description: Supports creating lab bills, adding tests or packages, collecting payments, and generating invoice PDFs.
user_flows: Navigate to /cases/bills/new -> Select a patient -> Add one or more tests or packages -> Create the invoice -> See the new bill in the billing list
Navigate to /cases/bills -> Open an unpaid bill -> Collect payment -> See the bill status change to Paid or Partial -> Open the invoice PDF or print view
Navigate to /cases/bills -> Open a bill with a public QR link -> Open the public bill verification page in a new session -> View bill details and download the PDF

features.name: Lab Reports and Results
features.description: Supports reviewing today’s reports, entering results, saving work, verifying reports, and downloading report PDFs.
user_flows: Navigate to /lab/reports -> Open a pending report -> Open result entry -> Enter numeric or text results -> Save the results -> Submit the report
Navigate to /lab/verification -> Open a reported case -> Sign the report -> Verify the report -> See the report status update to Verified
Navigate to /lab/reports -> Open a report preview -> Review the formatted report -> Download the staff PDF

features.name: Test Catalog
features.description: Lets staff browse and manage lab tests, packages, panels, categories, and rates.
user_flows: Navigate to /lab/tests -> Create a new test -> Enter test details -> Save the test -> See it in the database
Navigate to /lab/tests -> Search or browse existing tests -> Open a test for editing -> Update test details -> Save changes
Navigate to /lab/packages -> Review available packages -> Navigate to /lab/panels -> Review available panels -> Navigate to /lab/rates -> View the rate list

features.name: Business Analytics and Export
features.description: Provides administrative daily and monthly business views, expense tracking, and CSV export tools.
user_flows: Navigate to /business/daily -> Filter by date range -> Review the daily transaction summary
Navigate to /business/monthly -> View the monthly business summary -> Review the aggregated totals
Navigate to /business/expenses -> Review the expense list -> Navigate to /business/export -> Choose a dataset -> Export CSV data

features.name: USG Cases
features.description: Allows staff to view, create, update, and template ultrasound cases.
user_flows: Navigate to /usg/today -> View today's USG cases -> Create a new case -> Update the case details -> Save the case
Navigate to /usg/templates -> Review report templates -> Navigate to /usg/today -> Create or update a case using a template

features.name: X-Ray Cases
features.description: Supports creating X-Ray cases, uploading images, and reviewing X-Ray reports.
user_flows: Navigate to /xray/today -> View today's X-Ray cases -> Create a new case -> Upload one or more X-Ray images -> Save the case
Navigate to /xray/reports -> View the X-Ray report list -> Open a report for review

features.name: Lab Profile Setup
features.description: Lets administrators configure lab branding, letterhead, and document format options for generated documents.
user_flows: Navigate to /setup/profile -> Edit lab profile details -> Upload a logo or letterhead -> Adjust document format options -> Save the profile -> Preview the document PDF

features.name: Branch Management
features.description: Lets administrators create, update, delete, and filter branches used across the system.
user_flows: Navigate to /manage/branches -> Review the branch list -> Create a new branch -> Save the branch
Navigate to /manage/branches -> Open an existing branch -> Update branch details -> Save changes
Navigate to /manage/branches -> Open a branch record -> Delete the branch

features.name: Public Token Verification
features.description: Allows anyone with a valid token to verify the authenticity of a report or bill and download the document if available.
user_flows: Open /r/{token} -> View the verified report details -> Download the PDF if available
Open /r/bill/{token} -> View the verified bill details -> Download the PDF if available
Open an invalid public verification link -> See a message indicating the link is not valid
